newGaps.requirement: Reject duplicate, encoded-shadow, Unicode-compatibility-shadow, ambiguous separator and dangerous query keys at the API edge.
Allowlist child build environment and never emit environment values in receipts.
Repair all lexical-minifier selector and declaration corruption and pass both Webpack and Turbopack on final bytes.
Preserve 318 Shield, 318 Shield Pro/Map and 583 Real Markets unavailable or blocked rows when evidence is absent.
Bind active pass, authority, compatibility mirrors, descendant manifest and living roadmap to one sparse non-pass checkpoint.
Replace stale PASS35_OFFLINE_CANDIDATE_R3 binding with final frozen source and environment fingerprints before any staging credit.
Reconcile the stale 18-check staging plan with the canonical 19-case RLS matrix and execute all 19 against two disposable tenants.
Record export, PDF, derived-data, AI/RAG, cache, redistribution, retention, correction, attribution, exit, territory and SKU rights per provider.
Cryptographically verify signer identity, trust chain, timestamp, revocation, independence and conflict declaration.
Never grant 19/19 RLS credit from a structural preflight; require exactly 19 prepared, executed and passed cases against two disposable tenants.
Preserve the exact A42 immutable crash-log fixture while excluding all mutable runtime logs from SOURCE_ONLY.
Bind descendant and archive manifests and require forbidden-output absence before and after clean-unpack tests.
Validate embedded manifest schema, lineage, no-credit truth fields, unique canonical paths, exact bytes, path-set and aggregate before A58 can pass.
Emit SOURCE first, run clean-unpack, bind its receipt to exact archive and embedded manifest hashes, then admit MATERIALS packaging.
Reject missing, file, symlink or out-of-tree node_modules and TypeScript CLI before any dependency-backed clean-unpack step.
Keep the existing zero-warning lint budget and remove all 413 errors and 116 warnings without disables or threshold changes.

Serialize every mode/distDir writer with an atomic exclusive lock, bind the exact root BUILD_ID at phase boundaries, require exact root and standalone BUILD_ID equality, and report FAIL_OUTPUT_CONTRACT whenever the final output contract is false.

Define a dual-reviewed operator procedure that validates lock owner identity, process liveness, inode, frozen source and output state before removing an orphaned build lock; automatic lock stealing remains forbidden.

Keep exclusive build locks in private external runtime state namespaced by the canonical source root, disclose no raw host path, and require repeated absence checks after each build process and production smoke so workspace persistence replay cannot leave a false-success lock.

Exercise the production edge behind an explicit local simulated TLS reverse proxy without weakening fail-closed canonical-origin policy; separate process readiness from application status, use the real worker method, and replace stale source-text assertions with behavior.
Use raw ordering, normalize and assert modes, reject raw/NFKC/casefold collisions and compare every ZIP entry byte, hash, mode and order.
Build SOURCE independently before and after clean-unpack and build MATERIALS twice from frozen inputs; require identical SHA-256 and byte length.

Admit an authority-declared sparse ACTION_REQUIRED_NON_PASS child only with exact parent/digest, completed-through, omitted-pass no-credit and no-promotion truth; keep exact 30/30 execution separate from offline release-candidate eligibility.

Recognize the real bounded internal-worker mutation helper in the full API inventory and behaviorally prove 401, bounded-body 413, duplicate-key rejection and validation reachability for every worker route.

Model the server-owned production canonical origin in proxy tests, preserve fail-closed 503 on missing or invalid configuration and prove that request Host and forwarded headers cannot steer redirects.
Rebaseline the complete route-dispatch manifest after handler changes and make handler byte length an enforced tamper boundary alongside methods and SHA-256 for the full handler denominator.
Rebind every changed CSS file and the aggregate profile to current physical bytes while preserving parser-error, used-identifier and fixed budget thresholds.
Replace regex-only exported-method discovery with parser or registry-backed AST equivalence while retaining the complete handler, hash, byte-length and method denominator.

Keep the exact embedded archive-manifest field contract synchronized with the deterministic packager, record true local lint, smoke, current-root and freeze results, and preserve explicit false exact-release, browser, staging, LIVE and sale credit.
Keep every lazy shell method set exactly equal to its handler; the advanced-audit release shell must preserve POST, PUT and PATCH and reject future shell/handler drift.
Resolve both inline load imports and separately declared const load functions to the real mutation handler before awarding bounded-body coverage.
Retain and independently reverify all 450 physical synthetic PDFs and 2100 pages with exact materials binding; never convert renderer QA into real-data, customer-value or sale credit.

One fail-closed gate must preserve real denominators and SKU blockers for Audit, PDF, Shield, Shield Pro/Map, Real Markets, Market Impact, Whale Watch, Brain, Angel and Risk; synthetic readiness must never enable paid delivery.

Repeat the A94 Tailwind 3.4.19/PostCSS parser and both production builds on final A94R2 bytes with genuine lockfile dependencies; byte-identical CSS inputs preserve history but grant no new build/browser credit.
Exclude nested __pycache__ directories and .pyc files from source lineage and deterministic packages, reject them in packaged-tree admission, and preserve only source scripts as canonical code.
A58 and current authority verification must be read-only with respect to package-forbidden runtime artifacts; SOURCE identity excludes artifacts and verifier children use no-write mode.

Historical A94R2 cross-surface value verification must accept only an exact no-promotion current descendant bound to A94R2, rather than hardcoding A94R2 as permanently current or broadly accepting arbitrary revisions.
